sonnet.problem: This joke repeats the idea and shape of the joke on stop 1 card 18. Both set Joash's big moment against Papa Dorin's own small kitchen failure ("the only applause I get is my oven timer beeping" and "I can't find the oven mitts in my OWN bakery, and this kid is sitting on a throne").
